title: Privacy review before signature
requirement_text: Any new vendor, renewal, or material contract change involving personal data requires privacy review before contract signature or go-live.
objective: Prevent uncontrolled third-party disclosures and align procurement with privacy governance.

title: EEA hosting preference
requirement_text: Where feasible, services processing customer content should be hosted in the EEA; non-EEA hosting requires documented justification and compensating safeguards.
objective: Reduce transfer exposure for EU customer data.

title: Transfer impact assessment for restricted transfers
requirement_text: Before approving a vendor that receives data in a non-adequate jurisdiction, Acme must document the transfer mechanism, transfer impact assessment, and supplementary measures.
objective: Ensure cross-border transfers remain defensible and reviewable.

title: Annual privacy review for higher-risk vendors
requirement_text: Vendors processing customer data or supporting marketing operations must be re-reviewed at least annually and after major product or subprocessor changes.
objective: Keep due diligence current as vendor services evolve.

title: Advance notice of subprocessor changes
requirement_text: Vendors must give Acme reasonable prior notice of new subprocessors and a practical opportunity to object before customer data is disclosed onward.
objective: Maintain visibility and control over onward transfers.
